name: Dauntless Brace
description: Brace the whole frame under open sky and let a heavy blow spend itself on a body that does not recoil.

name: Unbowed Fist
description: Throw a straight fist with the head high and the will set forward past the target.

name: Sky Gauge
description: Gauge the clearness of the will in the user and in nearby allies the way a watcher reads the weather.

name: Lucid Breeze
description: Clear the muddle of a dazing blow or a clinging fear from the head of an ally or the user.

name: Uplift
description: Lift the spirit of an ally with a steady stream of clear will until the ally's limbs answer without lag.

name: Azure Counter
description: Take a blow upright and return a clean counter that breaks the foe's rhythm and stance together.

name: Heavenward Ward
description: Hold a broad ward of will lifted toward the sky that blunts blows falling from above and from the front alike.

name: Unbowed Drive
description: Drive forward through a rain of blows with the chin high and strike at the end of the advance.

name: Azure Recoil
description: Draw the whole force of a heavy blow into the user's will and send it back at the striker in one clear bolt.

name: Vowed Brace
description: Brace beside the line with a sworn word in the mind so no comrade is left bearing the blow alone.

name: Timed Blow
description: Strike in time with the line so the user's blow lands together with the comrades' blows.

name: Comrade Reading
description: Read the will of every comrade in the rank and find the one who is about to give.

name: Hearten Hand
description: Clasp the hand of a comrade whose nerve is thin and pass a thread of the user's own firmness into it.

name: Fatigue Mending
description: Draw the poison of fear and fatigue out of the whole rank in turn with a slow passing hand.

name: Steady Shoulders
description: Hold the comrades on either side steady with a shared guard that none of them can drop alone.

name: Breach Answer
description: Meet the foe who breaks into the rank with a hard answer that throws the foe back from the gap.

name: Skysworn Surge
description: Surge out of the rank at the foe with the rank's whole resolve driving the one blow.

name: Lent Firmness
description: Pour the user's will down the rank until every comrade stands as firm as the user stands.

name: Fellow Aegis
description: Raise one great shared ward across the whole rank and feed every comrade beneath it with the user's will.

name: Cold Fortitude
description: Meet a blow with a cold unmoved body that gives the foe no fear or fury to feed on.

name: Sapphire Jab
description: Jab with a clean cold point of will that pierces a guard with no heat or noise.

name: Stillness Read
description: Read the stillness in a person to tell whether it is true calm or held-down panic.

name: Cooling Word
description: Say one cool level word that draws the heat of rage or terror out of an ally.

name: Patient Gait
description: Advance at an even unhurried pace that the foe cannot rush or slow.

name: Calm Wash
description: Wash a rage or a terror out of an ally and leave the ally's mind as clear as cold water.

name: Unheated Blow
description: Deliver a heavy blow with no anger in it so the strike is exactly as hard as it was meant to be.

name: Stillness Lend
description: Lend a measure of the user's own stillness to an ally who is spinning toward panic.

name: Unchilled Ward
description: Hold the will so cold and level that a terror-aura or a rage-song finds nothing in the user to take hold of.

name: Sapphire Drive
description: Drive one cold hard strike through the foe's guard at the exact moment the guard is trusted.

name: Sapphire Stillness
description: Let a great hush fall over the fight that slows the foes and steadies every ally within it.

name: Zenith Stance
description: Take a tall upright stance whose weight is held in the centre and cannot be tipped.

name: Lucid Fist
description: Strike with a clear head and no wasted hope or fear in the arm.

name: Mind Sight
description: Look at a foe with a still mind and see what the foe is afraid of.

name: Lucid Word
description: Speak a plain true word to an ally that cuts through the ally's doubt.

name: Lucid Pace
description: Move across the ground with a clear mind and not one wasted step.

name: Doubt Dispel
description: Dispel a creeping doubt from the user or an ally before it settles into the legs.

name: Lucid Strike
description: Strike the single point on the foe's body that the clear mind has marked as the weakest.

name: Falsehood Glimpse
description: Glimpse the false step in a feint or a lie by the shift it makes in the foe's will.

name: Mind Ward
description: Ward the mind against a pressing will or a persuading voice so it cannot be bent.

name: Zenith Surge
description: Raise the will to its bright height and bring it down through one blow.

name: Dread Unmaking
description: Unmake a heavy dread laid on a group by an aura or a curse and leave the group able to move.

name: Zenith Mind
description: Lift the minds of all in the field to a bright still height where no dread or lie can follow.

name: Windlean Brace
description: Lean against the wind of a rush and hold the lean until the rush has passed.

name: Headlong Fist
description: Punch into the face of a charge and meet the foe's own speed with the user's own.

name: Gust Gauge
description: Gauge which way the push of the fight is leaning and who is being pushed.

name: Tailwind Word
description: Call a word that puts the push of the fight behind an ally rather than in the ally's face.

name: Turned Wind
description: Turn the rush of an attack aside with the flat of the arm and add the turn to the user's own motion.

name: Pressing Gale
description: Press forward in a hard continuous rush that gives the foe no room to settle.

name: Fresh Draught
description: Breathe a fresh clean draught of will into an ally and push out the stale weariness of the fight.

name: Windward Lunge
description: Lunge into the face of the wind of battle and arrive at the foe with the full pull of the rush behind the blow.

name: Tailwind Surge
description: Throw the weight of the user's will behind every ally at once so each of them moves with the wind at the back.

name: Headwind Mastery
description: Take the full roar of the wind of battle into the will and loose it as a single driving blow.

name: Pledge Armour
description: Clothe the body in a sworn word as in a coat that turns the first blow.

name: Pledged Knuckle
description: Hit with a knuckle set by a vow and a blow that remembers the oath.

name: Oath Weigh
description: Weigh how deeply the user and the allies are held by the words they swore.

name: Pledge Wash
description: Wash the guilt of a failed pledge from an ally so the ally can pledge again.

name: Oath Bolster
description: Speak the user's oath to an ally and bolster the ally with the oath's strength.

name: Pledged Blow
description: Strike on the closing word of an oath so the blow lands with the full weight of the promise.

name: Vowed Aegis
description: Raise a sworn guard that holds as long as the user holds to the word.

name: Oath Drive
description: Drive an oath through the foe's guard in a strike that cannot be turned from its mark.

name: Oathforged
description: Take a blow into the sworn will and forge from it a returning stroke that carries the oath's weight.

name: Stormeye Brace
description: Hold a still point in the middle of a storm of blows and let the storm turn round it.

name: Reined Fist
description: Hold the fist back through a long count and loose it at the end.

name: Storm Gauge
description: Gauge how much of the storm is left by the pace and weight of the blows.

name: Eyeward Word
description: Call an ally toward the still centre of the fight with one steady word.

name: Squall Shrug
description: Shrug a pressing wave of intimidation off the shoulders as if it were rain.

name: Loosed Fury
description: Loose all the fury held through the storm in a single short strike.

name: Storm Mending
description: Mend the shaken nerves of a company that has stood a long hour in the storm.

name: Held Storm
description: Gather the storm of every blow taken into a single long held breath and bring it down on the foe.

name: Eye Keeping
description: Keep a calm centre for the allies to gather round while the storm of blows passes outside it.

name: Loosed Tempest
description: Loose the whole held storm at the foe in one thunderous return that crushes the foe's will to continue.

name: Gale Hold
description: Hold the line against a hard blow like a post set deep in a gale.

name: Weathered Fist
description: Hit with a fist beaten hard by many seasons of exposure and effort.

name: Weather Sense
description: Read the coming change in a fight as an old hand reads a change in the sky.

name: Weathered Word
description: Say the words that have kept many a tired soul moving and pass them to an ally.

name: Ranging Gait
description: Take a long measured stride that eats the ground without spending the breath.

name: Fatigue Shed
description: Shed the heaviest of a long fight's fatigue from an ally in one release of will.

name: Marching Strike
description: Strike without breaking pace so the blow is just one more step of an unbroken advance.

name: Shared Reserve
description: Share a measure of the user's reserve of will with an ally who has run dry.

name: Endurance Ward
description: Hold a ward that does not weaken over a very long fight however many blows fall on it.

name: Long Mantle
description: Spread a long lasting mantle over the group that shields each one and feeds each one's staying power.

name: Weary Rousing
description: Rouse the most worn-out ally back on the feet and carry that ally through the next clash.

name: Gale Drive
description: Drive through the foe on the pent-up force of a hundred endured blows.

name: Fortitude Unending
description: Pour a deep unending fortitude into every ally in the field so that none of them tires for as long as the user stands.

name: Unfaltering Guard
description: Hold the guard through the whole of a blow without a flicker of doubt.

name: Steady Knuckle
description: Hit with a knuckle that does not shake at the moment of contact.

name: Faith Gauge
description: Gauge how much faith the comrades still have in the user and in one another.

name: Comrade Word
description: Say a comrade's name in the tone of a promise and the comrade finds the legs again.

name: Sure Pace
description: Advance at a sure pace that carries the line forward with it.

name: Falter Mend
description: Mend the crack of a first faltering in an ally before the crack widens into flight.

name: Unfaltering Blow
description: Deliver a heavy blow that does not slow or swerve however the foe moves.

name: Pledge Lift
description: Lift an ally by reminding the ally of the pledge that ally gave and sharing the strength of it.

name: Brink Call
description: Call back a comrade whose breath has just stopped by willing the comrade to answer; the window is short and every use is a heavy consequence.

name: Sworn Drive
description: Drive a sworn blow through the foe's guard at the user's whole strength.

name: Faith Unbroken
description: Cast a sworn shield over all comrades that no force can break while the user keeps faith with them.

name: Whirl Brace
description: Brace in the middle of a swirling melee and turn with the blows rather than against them.

name: Wild Fist
description: Throw a wide heated fist that grows more dangerous as the fight grows wilder.

name: Pressure Gauge
description: Gauge how near the storm of the fight is to its height by the pressure in the air.

name: Surge Word
description: Cry a word that sets an ally's will surging toward its peak.

name: Rage Cooling
description: Cool an ally's blind rage so the ally keeps its strength and loses its recklessness.

name: Rising Fury
description: Strike with a fury that rises with each blow the user has taken in the last breath.

name: Storm Veil
description: Draw a veil of whirling will round the user that scatters incoming blows.

name: Height Surge
description: Surge at the very height of the storm with a blow that holds back nothing.

name: Wild Rousing
description: Rouse the allies' wildest strength and keep it from running past their own control.

name: Full Tempest
description: Unleash the full tempest of the heart at the peak of the fight in a blow that shatters the foe's stance and technique together.
